[FACT] The data structure for IszCool Solutions will initially store parent and student details before parents create their first order.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The data structure that IszCool Solutions should use is a hash table.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] A hash table allows for fast and efficient storage and retrieval of data, using key-value pairs.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Keys in the hash table would be unique identifiers like StudentID or parent's email, while values would be associated data like parent's name or credit card number.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hash tables have a data manipulation time complexity of O(1), making them fast for real-time applications.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The other two control structures are selection control structure and iteration control structure.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The selection control structure allows the software to make decisions based on conditions, such as rejecting an order that exceeds the daily limit.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The iteration control structure allows the software to repeat instructions, such as checking each item in an order.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The selection control structure is most appropriate for editing a student's order because it allows staff to make decisions based on conditions.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Two characteristics of internal documentation are clarity and completeness.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Clarity means the documentation should be clear and easy to understand, while completeness means it should cover all aspects of the code.
